decisions.reason: OEWN explicitly defines adapting to a climate, matching the environmental adapt/familiarize anchors. Keep that narrower sourced meaning rather than claiming adaptation to every situation.
OEWN provides a self-contained clothing-accessory meaning matching the accessory anchor. Do not infer ceremonial register or equipment senses not selected here.
The sourced sour-taste adjective fits the taste aspect of acidic. It does not establish measured pH, a stronger acid, or an unsupported register comparison.
Profound love and admiration is the exact appropriate affection sense. The separate worship-of-God definition is not substituted for ordinary personal attachment.
OEWN verifies biological activity without free oxygen, but it does not establish equivalence to anaerobic exercise. Keep the organism/biology extension hidden in the Fitness context.
The annuity-recipient definition is precise financial vocabulary relevant to the pensioner anchor. It does not imply that every pensioner receives an annuity.

The available noun is genus-specific mosquito taxonomy, while the only learning anchor is general TOEIC mosquito. Preserve the earlier unresolved specialist-relevance decision; no malaria advice is approved.
Oxygen-deprivation or oxygen-absence meanings are not interchangeable with anaerobic exercise. The Fitness anchor does not establish a safe and accurate intended sense relationship.
The exact forearm definition is directly relevant anatomical terminology for Fitness. No claim that technical language is inherently better than forearm is promoted.
The human-related adjective is verified and appropriate for academic discussion of humanity. Restrict the specialist extension to Academic without fabricating list membership.
Opposing monopolies is a complete definition directly relevant to the Business antitrust anchor. No legal conclusion or comparative register claim is implied.
The selected antibody capable of neutralizing specific toxins fits the Academic antibody anchor. The separate medicine sense is not selected and no treatment advice is introduced.
The available senses concern apostolic office and spreading religious doctrine. The generic NGSL mission anchor alone does not justify this specialist theological expansion.
Belonging to or forming part of something is explained directly in the source, matching belong. No exclusive legal usage or unsupported register label is added.
Making a person aware of information directly matches inform/notify. Retain the source grammar labels and avoid implying that the verb necessarily describes repeated updates.
The architecture/design/construction adjective fits the architectural anchor. The philosophical knowledge-system and figurative moral-foundation meanings are not approved.
OEWN explicitly identifies a person specializing in arithmetic. Restrict to Academic and do not conflate the person with a calculator device used in Business or TOEIC.
The equipment-for-a-task definition includes a medical specialization and fits Academic technical resources. Do not broaden it to every Business repertoire or to unverified knowledge-based skills.
The arm opening in clothing is a clear garment-related meaning matching the sleeve context, without equating an opening with the sleeve itself.
The cupboard/cabinet/wardrobe definition fits furnishings. Its historical weapons use is preserved as source wording, without adding claims that every armoire is ornate or elegant.
The proposed Business dictator link confuses a political/business word with speech-production anatomy. Dental devices and vocal organs do not resolve that unsupported relationship.
A public song or dance performer fits entertainment/workplace performer vocabulary. Exclude the unsupported Fitness expansion and the separate skilled hairdresser/cook sense.

Rising levels, values or degrees is explicit in the selected definition and fits ordered values/trends. Retain attributive usage, excluding the separate slope meaning and ambiguous Fitness application.
Removing or protecting against pathogenic organisms is a standalone specialist hygiene meaning. Publish lexical meaning only, not an assurance that ordinary hygiene produces sterile conditions.
The definition explicitly explains capable of being attacked, fitting vulnerability. It is not an approval of every sense of vulnerable or any new relationship.
Great persistent effort is a self-contained match for workplace diligence. The separate solicitous-attention sense and comparative register claims are not selected.
The non-citizen granted asylum definition clearly distinguishes this status from the broader refugee anchor. This is vocabulary, not legal eligibility advice.
The atoms/atomism adjective matches the Academic atomic anchor. It is not used to publish the unrelated economic-market or general fragmented-structure senses.
The source verifies an uncommon listener noun, but the Business/TOEIC auditor anchor is likely the accounting occupation. Keep the uncertain sense correspondence hidden.
Mental sound imagery is specialist psychology and the ordinary TOEIC audition context does not establish that meaning. Do not validate an auditory learning-style claim from this noun.
The sourced hearing-related adjective is valid, but the TOEIC audition anchor may mean a performance trial. Its intended sense correspondence remains uncertain.
The selected source explicitly names the outer ear/pinna, with its ear-shaped-appendage context preserved. Restrict anatomical precision to Academic and do not select the cardiac atrium meanings.
The candidates mix autocratic governance and self-sufficiency; the original autonomous Business link conflates them. The prior scope/sense ambiguity remains unresolved.
The relationship between a man and his sister's children is self-contained anthropology vocabulary. Restrict to Academic; do not substitute tribe-specific duties or the separate marriage adjective.
